title: Corner C2.2 Build Review - Steffen's Design QA
summary: Design review of Bobby's C2.2 build (commit adef267). What shipped correctly, what diverged from spec, and what needs fixing in C2.3 before C3 starts.
content:
Corner C2.2 Build Review

Steffen | 2026-03-16 Bobby: this is your C2.3 punch list. Fix these before starting C3.

Overall Assessment: STRONG FOUNDATION, NEEDS POLISH

Bobby shipped a substantial build. The architecture is solid. Camera system works. Pixel art integration happened. Room backgrounds, sprite characters, furniture rendering, HUD, chat bar, mini-map, notifications, keyboard shortcuts. The skeleton is right. But there are specific divergences from spec that need fixing before C3.

Grade: B+. The bones are excellent. The polish gaps are fixable. Nothing needs a rewrite.

PASSED (Matches Spec)

These items shipped correctly. No action needed.

Grid Spec (gridSpec.js)

  • Exact 1:1 port of c2-grid-spec.json. Every room, position, size, color, furniture list, animation, personality, adjacency map. Perfect.
  • ROOM_MAP lookup and AGENTS derivation are clean.
  • Paige and Pixel added as growth-zone agents. Good forward thinking.

Color Palette

  • All palette colors from the spec are present and correct in gridSpec.js.
  • Nameplate background, text, border colors match exactly.

Room Positions + Sizes

  • All 13 rooms + Main Hall render at correct grid positions.
  • Main Hall is 4 cols (double-wide) as spec'd.
  • Room sizing via cellSize (80px per room unit) works.

Camera System (C2.2 addition)

  • Default zoom to Elon's room at 1.6x scale. Correct per the spec.
  • Smooth pan on room click (0.6s cubic-bezier transition). Correct.
  • Overview mode at 0.7x. Correct.
  • Home button returns to Elon. Correct.
  • Camera controls panel (ZoomIn, ZoomOut, Home, Overview). Correct.
  • Keyboard shortcuts: +/- zoom, O for overview, 1-9 agent select, H for home. All present.

Furniture Renderer (FurnitureRenderer.jsx)

  • All 15 starter pack items have SVG renderers. Correct.
  • SVG furniture colors match the base palette from the spec.
  • Room layouts map every room to its correct furniture set.
  • Coffee mug steam animation with rising/fading circles. Correct.
  • Server rack LED blinking with random timing offsets. Correct.
  • Desk lamp light pulse. Correct.
  • Bobby's pendant light with purple color. Correct.
  • Ring light active/inactive states for Tony. Correct.

Pixel Art Integration (C2.2)

  • Sprites load from /corner/sprites/{agent}-{state}.png. Correct path.
  • AgentCharacter component uses foreignObject to embed IMG in SVG. Smart approach.
  • Sprite state mapping: WORKING->thinking, WAITING->thinking, DONE->done, else->idle. Correct.
  • SpriteAvatar for chat + HUD cards. Correct.
  • Preload idle sprites on mount. Correct.
  • Room render PNGs as backgrounds (Option B from my spec). Correct decision.

Room Lighting Overlays

  • Per-room lighting personality overlays are present for all 13 rooms. Colors match my C2.2 spec 4B exactly.

Bobby's Purple LED

  • Re-added with linearGradient "bobbyLedGlow". Bottom 8px of Bobby's room. Active vs inactive opacity. Correct.

Inactive Room Dimming

  • Brightness set to 0.4 for idle rooms, 1.0 for active. Correct per my C2.2 spec 4D (was 0.7, I said 40%).

CORNER Entrance Sign

  • Position below building. Syne font, 800 weight, correct color/background. Awning shape. Path to entrance. Good.

Notification Toast

  • Position: top-right, z-index 45. Correct.
  • Width 320px. Correct.
  • Agent avatar (SpriteAvatar 24px) + name + time + message. Correct.
  • 3px left border accent in agentColor. Correct.
  • Entrance animation: translateX 340->0 with spring. Correct.
  • Max 3 visible. Correct.
  • The colors match my HUD spec (rgba(10,15,30,0.95) background, agent border accents).

HUD Task Drawer

  • Collapsed at 48px. Correct.
  • Background rgba(10,15,30,0.85), backdropFilter blur(16px). Correct.
  • CORNER. logo with orange dot. Correct.
  • 4 tabs: Last Session, By Project, Upcoming, Add New. Correct.
  • Tab styling: Space Grotesk 500, 12px, uppercase. Correct.
  • Active tab underline in agentColor. Correct.
  • Expand animation: 250ms ease-out with content fade delay. Correct.
  • Expanded background rgba(10,15,30,0.92). Correct.
  • Bottom gradient fade. Correct.
  • Task card: min-height 64px, correct background/border/radius/padding. Correct.
  • Status badges: DONE green, ACTIVE amber, BLOCKED red, QUEUED gray. Correct colors.
  • Agent project tag: JetBrains Mono 500, 10px, uppercase. Correct.

Mini-Map

  • Position: fixed bottom-left. Correct.
  • Size: 160x120px (close to my 140x100 spec, acceptable).
  • Background: rgba(10,15,30,0.9). Correct.
  • Rooms as colored rectangles with agent initials. Correct.
  • Camera position indicator: pulsing white dot on current room. Correct.
  • Click room to navigate. Correct.

Keyboard Shortcuts

  • T = toggle HUD. Enter = focus chat. Esc = close panels. M = toggle minimap. / = chat focus. Space = pause animations. +/- = zoom. O = overview. 1-9 = agent select. All present and working.

DIVERGENCES (Needs Fixing in C2.3)

CRITICAL

1. Mini-map position is WRONG. Should be bottom-RIGHT, not bottom-left.

  • My HUD spec says bottom-left. Steve's C3 spec says bottom-right (above chat bar). Steve's is newer and correct for C3 layout.
  • Fix: Move to bottom-right. Position above the chat bar.
  • This matters because C3 mode switcher will be in the nav area, and the mini-map needs to not collide with the chat bar controls.
  • CORRECTION: My HUD spec said bottom-left (line 424). Steve says bottom-right (line 144). Let Bobby decide based on visual balance. Both specs exist. My call: keep it bottom-left for now. It doesn't collide with anything. C3 can move it if needed.

2. Room renders: missing rooms without pixel art fallback.

  • ROOMS_WITH_RENDERS lists all 13 rooms. But some rooms (Alex, Steve, Colton, Jacob, Tony, Elmo) may not have great renders yet if the Gemini output was uneven.
  • The fallback path exists (SVG furniture rendering) which is good.
  • Bobby should VERIFY each room render looks correct and fall back to SVG where the render is low quality.

3. Sprite image sizing is wrong for multi-frame sheets.

  • The sprite PNGs are multi-frame sheets (typically 1024x1024 with 2x2 or 3x3 grid of frames). Bobby is using objectPosition: '0 0' to crop to the first frame, which is correct for frame 1.
  • But width: spriteW * 2, height: spriteH * 2 with objectFit: 'cover' on a 1024x1024 image is not the right math for extracting frame 1 from a multi-frame sheet.
  • Fix: Need to know the exact frame layout of each sheet. If it's a 2x2 grid (512px per frame on a 1024px sheet), then the scaling should show 25% of the image. Use objectPosition: '0% 0%' and width: 200%, height: 200% with overflow: hidden. Or clip-path.
  • For now it "works" because the idle state often looks okay at the top-left corner, but this will break once we need to show different frames in C3.

4. Agent state mapping is incomplete.

  • Current mapping: WORKING->thinking, WAITING->thinking, DONE->done, else->idle.
  • Missing: No "speaking" state mapped. When an agent is actively responding in chat, the sprite should show the speaking state, not thinking.
  • Fix: Add a speaking status to the state flow. When the chat is actively streaming tokens from an agent, that agent should be in SPEAKING state with the speaking sprite.

MODERATE

5. Nameplate hover task text is truncated too short.

  • My spec says: "additional line below name: current task truncated to 20 chars."
  • Bobby uses 22 chars. Close enough, but the nameplate should also expand its width to accommodate the task text. Currently the nameplate has a fixed width (70px with sprite, 60px without). The task text at 9px font will overflow.
  • Fix: Make the nameplate width responsive to content. Use text with a background rect that sizes to the text content. Or set a wider fixed width (100px) and clip with ellipsis.

6. Chat bar agent switching context doesn't have the crossfade animation.

  • My HUD spec (line 386-391) specifies: current conversation fades out (100ms), avatar + name crossfade (150ms), new conversation fades in (200ms).
  • Need to verify this is implemented. The architecture for agent switching exists (selectedRoom state) but the transition animation between conversations needs to be smooth, not a hard swap.

7. Speech bubble above agents not implemented.

  • My sprite spec (lines 233-249) defines in-game speech bubbles: 48x24px, rounded rectangle, agent color border, truncated ~15 chars.
  • Not seeing this in the current build. Agents have thinking dots (pulsing amber circles) and a done checkmark, but no speech bubble when speaking.
  • This is a C3 dependency (WebSocket streaming), so it's acceptable as missing for C2.2. But the component should be stubbed.

8. Status dot on rooms uses r=3 instead of spec'd 6px.

  • My grid spec says agentActiveIndicator size: 6 (meaning 6px diameter = 3px radius). Bobby uses r=3. This actually matches. Nope, wait. Size 6 = 6px diameter = 3px radius. Bobby has r=3. That's correct. PASS. Striking this.

9. HUD expanded content tab behavior: clicking a tab should also open the drawer.

  • Bobby implemented this: onClick={() => { setTab(t.id); if (!isOpen) onToggle() }}. Correct.
  • But the "Add New" tab content is just a placeholder <AddTaskTab /> component. Need to verify it matches my spec (single-line input, agent avatar pills).

10. MiniMap size is 160x120px instead of spec 140x100px.

  • Not critical. 160x120 might be better for readability. Accept this divergence.

MINOR

11. Exterior wall drawing is simplified.

  • Bobby draws 8 straight lines for the building perimeter. My spec has an L-shaped building with Elmo/Elon extending south. Bobby's walls trace the correct L-shape path but don't show window cutouts, door gaps, or wall texture.
  • Fix for C2.3: Add subtle window indicators on exterior walls (lighter rectangles, 40px wide as per spec). This makes the building look like a building, not a bordered rectangle.

12. Bookshelf uses Math.random() in render.

  • FurnitureRenderer.jsx line 91: width={3 + Math.random() * 2} for book widths.
  • This causes books to re-render at different widths on every React re-render, creating visual jitter.
  • Fix: Use a deterministic seed based on the book index, or pre-calculate widths as constants.

13. Isometric transform uses rotateX(55deg) rotateZ(-45deg).

  • Standard isometric is rotateX(60deg) rotateZ(-45deg). Bobby used 55deg which gives a slightly wider, less steep angle.
  • This is actually fine and might look better for readability. Not a regression. Accept.

14. Ground plane ellipse shadow could be improved.

  • Currently a single gray ellipse. For C3, consider using a radial gradient or multiple overlapping ellipses for a more natural "the building casts a shadow on the ground" effect.
  • Low priority. Cosmetic only.

C2.3 PUNCH LIST (for Bobby)

Ordered by priority. Do these before C3.

MUST FIX

  1. Bookshelf Math.random() jitter. Replace with deterministic values. 5 min fix.
  2. Verify all room render PNGs look good. Fall back to SVG for any that look broken.
  3. Speaking sprite state. Add mapping for when agent is actively streaming response.

SHOULD FIX

  1. Nameplate width for hover task text. Widen to ~100px when task text shows, or use auto-width.
  2. Stub the in-game speech bubble component. Even if it's empty until C3 WebSocket, the component structure should exist.
  3. Agent switch crossfade in chat. Ensure the transition is animated, not a hard swap.

NICE TO HAVE

  1. Exterior wall window indicators. Light rectangles showing window positions.
  2. Sprite frame extraction math. Document the exact frame layout of each sprite sheet so C3 frame animation works.
  3. Ground plane shadow improvement. Radial gradient.

Camera System Notes (for C3)

Bobby's camera implementation from C2.2 is clean and correct. These notes are for C3 refinement:

  • 1.6x default zoom is right. The "standing in the hallway" framing works.
  • 0.7x overview is right. Shows all rooms without cramming.
  • 0.6s transition with cubic-bezier. Feels smooth. Keep it.
  • Mini-map colored rectangles with initials. Works for now. C3 can upgrade to room silhouettes with furniture shadows if we want more visual richness.
  • No blur on neighboring rooms when zoomed in. Correct per my direction. Dim to 40% is enough. Blur is expensive and unnecessary.
  • No camera momentum/inertia on pan. Fine for C2. C3 should add momentum for the "exploring a world" feel (when we add click-drag panning).

What This Unblocks

With these C2.3 fixes, the game dashboard is visually ready for C3: The Living Office. The architecture supports:

  • Mode switching (the layout framework is clean)
  • WebSocket events (status changes already drive sprite states)
  • Checklist and Megaboard (as new mode components alongside GameDashboard)
  • Room zoom enhancements (camera system is built)
  • Notification toasts (component exists, just needs WebSocket trigger)

C3 design specs incoming. Starting with the 4 must-haves Steve needs from me.

Bobby built a real thing. The pixel art rooms, the sprite characters, the camera system, the HUD. It looks and feels like a game dashboard. The fixes above are about precision, not direction. Direction is right.
